description: This file manages Telegram reaction emojis, including supported emojis, reaction variants for different statuses, normalization, and extraction of allowed reactions from chat details. It provides functions to resolve emoji variants, check support, and handle chat-specific reaction permissions.

methods.name: normalizeEmoji
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns undefined if input is undefined or empty.

methods.name: toUniqueNonEmpty
methods.description: Creates a unique array of non-empty, trimmed strings from input array.

methods.name: resolveTelegramStatusReactionEmojis
methods.description: Generates a set of status reaction emojis, applying overrides and defaults.

methods.name: buildTelegramStatusReactionVariants
methods.description: Builds a map of requested emojis to their variant sets based on configuration.

methods.name: isTelegramSupportedReactionEmoji
methods.description: Checks if an emoji is supported by Telegram reactions.

methods.name: extractTelegramAllowedEmojiReactions
methods.description: Extracts allowed emoji reactions from chat details, considering chat-specific restrictions.

methods.name: resolveTelegramAllowedEmojiReactions
methods.description: Asynchronously determines allowed emoji reactions for a chat, possibly via API call.

methods.name: resolveTelegramReactionVariant
methods.description: Resolves a requested emoji to a supported, allowed reaction emoji based on variants and chat permissions.
